query: SELECT pt.id, pt.plant_id, pt.terroir_id, pt.local_name, pt.quality_notes, p.name as plant_name, t.name as terroir_name FROM plant_terroirs pt JOIN plants p ON pt.plant_id = p.id JOIN terroirs t ON pt.terroir_id = t.id WHERE pt.plant_id IN (420003, 420004, 420011) ORDER BY pt.plant_id, pt.terroir_id;
